hook.text: CIA analysts tracked a courier for years. He led them to a compound in Pakistan. Inside was Osama bin Laden.

buildup.text: The hunt took ten years after 9/11. Traditional spycraft — tracking humans — succeeded where technology alone failed.

discovery.text: Intelligence work is patient. The breakthrough came from one phone number, traced through a network of contacts.

twist.text: Pakistan's military academy was one mile from the compound. Questions about Pakistani complicity remain unanswered.

climax.text: SEAL Team Six executed the raid in 40 minutes. A decade of intelligence reduced to half an hour of action.

punchline.text: Years of patience for minutes of precision.

quiz.question: What intelligence method ultimately located bin Laden?
options: Tracking a courier through human intelligence networks
Intercepting phone calls from the compound
